name: PSYC 5424
title: Cognitive Neuroscience of Language Across the Lifespan
description: (Also offered as COGS 5150.) The cognitive neuroscience approach to the study of language across the lifespan. Recent advances in neuroimaging techniques such as MRI, ERP, TMS, and fNIRS are combined with classic lesion studies to address the neurobiological bases of typical and atypical language processing.
requirement_description: Open to Graduate students in PSYC, LING, SLHS; others with consent of instructor.
